# Upstream workflow reference

These files are preserved from the source distribution as reference. They use upstream release branches, Python publishing, Unity licensing secrets, and GitHub Pages settings that have not been configured for `Noongits/unity-light-mcp-rust`.

They live outside `.github/workflows` so they do not run or publish from this repository. Adapt and validate the relevant jobs before enabling them. Local Rust, Unity, and website verification is documented in `INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md`.
